name: mobile-termux
description: Mobile deployment of Dreamcoder on Termux for the Moshi agent. Repository-safe: contains no device address, username, key, or host runtime state.
notes: Mobile profile pins Dreamcoder Light and keeps Herdr pane scrollbars disabled (matching the Herdr 0.8.0 default) for narrow screens. It carries rendering settings only; never device or session state.
